title: Phone text fields stay 16px in landscape, and the zoom check names the field (RF-189 review follow-ups)
acceptance: The 16px phone text-field rule also applies to a phone turned sideways (a touch screen under 640px tall and under 960px wide; the widest landscape iPhone is 956px), so a landscape iPhone does not zoom on focus; tablets and desktops keep their own sizes, even when a keyboard shrinks a tablet viewport.

The e2e zoom check uses the same media query as index.css, checks the sign-up form at 844x390 on the touch phone project, and its failure message falls back from aria-label to id to name (`||`, since a missing id is "").
nextAction: Owner: with the RF-189 iPhone check after the next deploy, also turn the iPhone sideways and tap the sign-in Email field and Music › Songs Search songs; the page must not zoom. Then set Done. CI proves this only in Chromium touch emulation.
